Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 81 (Applied Digital missing-address campaign): resolved an earlier passs flagged uncertainty over whether this Harwood, ND row matched the operators publicized developments, confirming via two independent aggregator pages that this is Polaris Forge 2, a 3 billion dollar, 900 acre AI focused campus. No complete numbered street address found, two partial road name leads (Truman Drive per reverse geocode, 45th Street North per aggregator) recorded but not applied as an address.

[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] An earlier pass on file for this operator found the companys own site describing large North Dakota developments in Jamestown and Ellendale, but could not confirm whether this registry rows own Harwood, North Dakota location was the same project, a separate site, or a geocoding difference. This session resolved that flag. A data center industry aggregator directorys general Fargo area listing, and separately its own dedicated facility page, both independently name a facility called Polaris Forge 2, operated by this company, located within Harwood, Cass County, North Dakota, describing a 3 billion dollar AI focused data center campus on a 900 acre parcel. This is distinct from the companys separately publicized Jamestown and Ellendale developments and from a Delta Forge 2 project the companys own site describes with a 210 MW lease elsewhere, the company appears to operate a family of similarly named Forge campuses, including Polaris Forge 1 and Polaris Forge 3 per its own recent investor materials. No complete, numbered street address was found for Polaris Forge 2 specifically. Reverse geocoding this rows own stored coordinates through a third party service returned only a nearby road name without a house number, Truman Drive, at 0.9 confidence, and the aggregators dedicated facility page separately gives only an internal road designation, 45th Street North, also without a house number, so this session applies neither as a complete address, but records both as leads for a future researcher alongside the confirmed Polaris Forge 2 facility identity.
